findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, http, extract, x402_check, x402_check_deep, bazaar_check, discourse_split, watch, grocery_normalize, grocery_ingredient, batch, market_quote, screenshot, search, pdf, money_market_rates · Private data: portfolio, fetch, http, extract, bazaar_check, tx_status, tokenized_stock, watch, balance, tx_guard, token_meta, batch, screenshot, submit_feedback, verified_brief_quote · Public sink: http, extract, x402_check, discourse_split, grocery_normalize, grocery_ingredient, name_resolve, batch, market_quote, sec_company_facts, money_market_rates, submit_feedback · Destructive: fetch, http, screenshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, http, extract, x402_check, x402_check_deep, bazaar_check, discourse_split, watch, grocery_normalize, grocery_ingredient, batch, market_quote, screenshot, search, pdf, money_market_rates · Private data: portfolio, fetch, http, extract, bazaar_check, tx_status, tokenized_stock, watch, balance, tx_guard, token_meta, batch, screenshot, submit_feedback, verified_brief_quote · Public sink: http, extract, x402_check, discourse_split, grocery_normalize, grocery_ingredient, name_resolve, batch, market_quote, sec_company_facts, money_market_rates, submit_feedback · Destructive: fetch, http, screenshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verified_brief_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
